content.text: Atlassian hides emailAddress depending on the site's privacy setting, and this install shows it.
live default mirror: 7163 issues, 6783 assigned, 1027 of those (15.1%) have an empty assignee_email; 950 reporters likewise
examples/demo.db: 534 issues, 264 assigned, 0 with an empty email (the 270 empties are unassigned, not hidden)

`gadak assign --help` reads `<email|->`, and the skill documents the empty-email trap without offering a way through. The UI stopped depending on email visibility some time ago and keys on account id.

The capability is already half there: resolveAccount (cmd/gadak/agent.go:1489-1529) tries an email match and then falls back to SearchUsers, accepting a single hit. What is missing is that the usage, the help and the skill never say so, and an ambiguous name does not print candidates.

Fix shape: usage becomes <email|name|accountId|->; zero or multiple hits exit non-zero listing the display names, the same failure shape `gadak transition` uses; the skill's assign example stops assuming an email. issuetap already answers GET /user/search, so this is not a standalone divergence.
Gate: a user with no email and one name match is accepted by id; two matches exit non-zero naming both; the existing email path is unchanged.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track B, score 7/10).
